verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB has a dedicated ingestion doc stating that INSERT, the Kafka table engine, s3()/url() table functions and materialized views work as documented. It also recommends async inserts to buffer small streaming writes, all over the native/HTTP ClickHouse interfaces. However, nothing documents how quickly streamed writes become queryable on its object-storage layer, so the "within seconds" freshness is unproven. missing for 10: documented end-to-end ingest-to-query latency/freshness guarantees, a dedicated streaming-specific API reference beyond inherited ClickHouse mechanisms, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time visibility
